The '''''Event Horizon''''' was a [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] which was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Kuati Sector Forces]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict fought between the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and later its successor state, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The ''Event Horizon'', along with the rest of the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], guarded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], home to [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]&mdash;a key [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] for the Galactic Empire. During the New Republic [[Taking of Kuat|offensive]] in 8.5 ABY, a Republic [[Coded eraser virus|virus]] in the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] networks of the ''Event Horizon'' caused it to close its [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] while turning its [[Turbolaser/Legends|guns]] on the rest of the Kuati fleet.

==Description==
A [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]], the ''Event Horizon'' had multiple [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|batteries]]. Its systems were also vulnerable to [[Computer/Legends|computer]] viruses.<ref name="Warfare" />

==History==
The ''Event Horizon'' was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Kuati Sector Forces]]<ref name="Warfare" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which was later replaced by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], fought against the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Empire. The ''Event Horizon'' guarded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], home to the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Shipyard/Legends|ship building facilities]], a vital component to the Empire's war effort. Some of the many [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] in Kuat Drive Yards' [[Droid/Legends|droid]] pool at that [[Time/Legends|time]] had been inserted by New Republic [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]], and those astromechs uploaded a coded computer [[Coded eraser virus|virus]] into the networks of the ''Event Horizon'' and four other [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="Warfare" />

Once the virus was installed, a transmission was sent from the ''Event Horizon'' to the New Republic's [[Surprise Squadron]] in the [[Venir system/Legends|Venir system]], a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] composed of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] armed with [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion]] [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]]. Surprise Squadron [[Taking of Kuat|arrived]] in the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]], and their ion weaponry soon overloaded the systems of four warships while the virus installed in the ''Event Horizon'' and the other inflicted ships caused those vessels to lock down their hangars and aim their batteries at the remains of the Kuati fleet. The [[Minister of Commerce]] of the New Republic, [[Ral'Rai Muvunc]], hailed the Kuati officials and revealed that the New Republic controlled thirty-four percent of the company's shares. As they faced an enemy who could disable nine warships&mdash;one of them the ''Event Horizon''&mdash;from their defense force in a matter of [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], as well as one who controlled a substantial portion of their shares, the Kuati officials surrendered to the Republic.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Event Horizon'' was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] released in [[2012]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
